If they take @DamageNeededToAwaken@ damage, they wake up and take an additional @WakeupDamage@ max Health magic damage.

ability.name: Petrified Bark
ability.desc: Gain @ShieldCalc1@ AP Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds and become petrified. When the shield breaks, unleash a wave of dark energy, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ APArmorMR magic damage to enemies within @AoEHexRange@ hexes.

ability.name: Withering Curse
ability.desc: Passive: Gain @Omnivamp@ Omnivamp. \n \nActive: Fire a dark blast at @NumEnemiesCursed@ nearby enemies, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ AP magic damage to them and cursing them for @SpellDuration@ seconds. Then, spawn a @HexRangeAOE@ Hex withering zone for the same duration that deals @MagicDamageCalc2@ AP magic damage per second. Cursed enemies take @MagicDamageCalc3@ AP more damage per curse.

ability.name: Javelin Toss
ability.desc: Adaptor AP: Gain @BonusAttackSpeed@ Attack Speed for the next @NumEmpoweredAttacks@ attacks. These attacks are replaced with javelins that deal @MagicDamageCalc1@ AP magic damage. The 3rd attack instead targets the furthest enemy with the least items and deals @MagicDamageCalc2@ AP magic damage. \n \nAdaptor AD: Transform into a Melee cougar Assassin that swipes enemies.

ability.name: Azure Shockwave
ability.desc:
Gain @ShieldCalc1@ APHP Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds. Slam the ground, sending a fissure in the direction of the most enemies. Enemies hit are briefly knocked up, take @MagicDamageCalc1@ AP magic damage, and are Mana Reaved for @ManaReaveFlat@. 
 
Blue Buff: Each time Sentinel casts, allies gain @TraitAlliesManaRegen@ Mana Regen. 
 
Mana Reave: Increase the Mana cost of the next Ability cast.

ability.name: Haymaker
ability.desc: Passive: Upon falling below @ManaHPThreshold@ max Health the first time each combat, gain 100 mana. \n \nActive: Wind up a big punch, rapidly healing for @HealthCalc1@ HPAP before dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ HPAD physical damage in a large cone.

ability.name: Boomerang Blade
ability.desc: Throw a large crossblade that deals @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ ADAP physical damage to the current target and bounces @NumBounces@ times between nearby enemies, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc2@ ADAP physical damage each bounce. When this kills an enemy, bounce @BonusKillBounces@ additional times.

ability.name: Starcall
ability.desc: Call down a star on the current target, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ AP magic damage. If a star has previously fallen on them, call down @NumAdditionalStars@ additional stars that each deal @MagicDamageCalc2@ AP magic damage.

ability.name: Rampant Growth
ability.desc: Spawn @NumPlantsToSpawn@ plants around the battlefield that attack the nearest enemy @ThornSpitterNumAttacks@ times. Each attack deals @MagicDamageCalc1@ AP magic damage.

ability.name: Moonfall
ability.desc: Rain @NumMoonshards@ moonshards split among the @NumEnemies@ nearest enemies, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ AP magic damage each. \n \nIf the moon is full, instead crash it onto the board, dealing @MagicDamageCalc2@ AP magic damage split among all enemies.

ability.name: Spirit Rift
ability.desc:
Fire an arrow through the most enemies in a line that deals @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ AD physical damage, reduced by @DamageFalloffPerEnemy@ per enemy hit (minimum @MinDamagePercent@). 
 
The arrow leaves a trail for @RiftDuration@ seconds that deals @PhysicalDamageCalc2@ ADAP + @MaxHealthDamagePerSecond@ max Health physical damage per second to enemies within and @ChillPercent@% Slows them. 
 
Slow: Reduce Attack Speed

ability.name: Whirling Death
ability.desc: Passive: Attacks target random enemies in range and apply a bleed that deals @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ AD physical damage over @BleedDuration@ seconds. Every attack has a @GenericCalc1@ AP chance to deal @SpinningAxeDamageRatio@ bonus physical damage and apply @SpinningAxeBleedStacks@ bleeds instead. \n \nActive: Throw two giant axes towards the enemy with the most bleeds. Deal @PhysicalDamageCalc3@ AD physical damage to enemies hit and consume their bleed, instantly dealing the remaining damage. The axes then return, dealing @GenericCalc2@ AD physical damage to enemies hit.

ability.name: Heat Without Equal
ability.desc:
Passive: Attacks deal @AttackAoERatio@ damage to enemies adjacent to the target. 
 
Active: Become invulnerable and fly into the air. On return, stun all enemies for @StunDuration@ seconds, gain @Omnivamp@ Omnivamp, and Ignite them for @IgniteDuration@ seconds. Ignited enemies take @IgniteMaxHealthDamage@ max Health physical damage per second. Replace this ability with Flame Breath and immediately cast it. 
 
Flame Breath: Spew fire at the most enemies in a line through the target, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc2@ ADAP physical damage, reduced by @DamageReductionPerHit@ for each enemy it passes through (minimum @MinimumDamageThreshold@.) Ignite those enemies for @IgniteDuration@ seconds. 
 
Elder Dragon Buff: Damaging an enemy below @TraitExecuteThreshold@ Health executes them.

ability.name: Rage Gene
ability.desc:
Passive: Gain @RagePerSecond@ Rage per second and @RagePerAttack@ Rage per attack. 
 
Active: Transform into Mega Gnar and leap into the largest group of enemies within @TransformSearchRadius@ hexes. Then, deal @PhysicalDamageCalc3@ AD physical damage to enemies within @TransformHexRadius@ hexes, reduce their Armor and Magic Resist by @GenericCalc1@ AP, and Stun them for @StunDuration@ second. Mega Gnar gains @HealthCalc1@ Health, and replaces his Ability with Grab n' Throw. 
 
Grab n' Throw: Throw the target at the farthest enemy, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ AD physical damage to them and @PhysicalDamageCalc2@ AD physical damage to enemies they pass through. If there's only 1 enemy left, throw them off the battlefield instead.

ability.name: Triggerseed
ability.desc: Passive: Shields from this Ability can critically strike with Precision. \n \nActive: Grant @NumAlliesToShield@ allies @ShieldCalc1@ AP%i:scaleDA% Shield and @DamageAmpAmount@ Damage Amp for @ShieldDuration@ seconds. Then deal @MagicDamageCalc1@ AP magic damage to enemies adjacent to them. After casting @CastThreshold@ times, also grant @AttackSpeed@ stacking Attack Speed to targets.

ability.name: Firestorm
ability.desc: Charge up, gaining @APPerBurningEnemy@ Ability Power per Burning enemy. Then, gain @ShieldCalc1@ AP Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds and rush through a nearby group of enemies, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ AP magic damage to each. \n \nAfter rushing, unleash a @FirestormHexRadius@ Hex firestorm that deals a total of @MagicDamageCalc2@ AP magic damage split among all enemies hit over @FirestormDuration@ seconds.

ability.name: Final Spark
ability.desc: Passive: On cast, all allies that share a trait with Lux gain @ManaCalc1@ AP mana. \n \nActive: Fire a laser towards the largest group of enemies that deals @MagicDamageCalc1@ AP magic damage, reduced by @DamageReductionPerUnit@ for each enemy hit.

ability.name: Sow the Seeds
ability.desc: Passive: After every @DamageMitigatedPerSapling@ damage blocked, a sapling jumps towards a nearby enemy and deals @MagicDamageCalc1@ HP magic damage. On death, @SaplingsOnDeath@ saplings jump out. \n \nActive: Deal @MagicDamageCalc2@ HP magic damage to target and restore @HealthCalc1@ AP + @ActiveMissingHealthHeal@ missing Health.

ability.name: Emerald Radiance
ability.desc: Passive: The first time Taric or his paired ally drops below @PassivePercentHealthThreshold@ Health, unleash emerald energy from both of them, granting @ShieldCalc1@ HP Shield to allies within @PassiveHexRadius@ Hexes for @PassiveShieldDuration@ seconds. \n \nActive: Restore @HealthCalc1@ AP Health. Taric and his paired ally deal @MagicDamageCalc1@ AP bonus magic damage on their next @NumAttacks@ attacks.
